verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents all three forms of team-rule encoding. Natural-language rules come through glob-scoped path instructions (docs-8, docs-48) and chat-taught learnings applied to future reviews (docs-7, docs-51). AST rules come through ast-grep-powered review instructions (docs-9, docs-49). Style guides come from automatic detection of guideline files such as CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and .cursorrules, which are applied as review criteria (docs-10). Org-wide central configuration (docs-14) and a request-changes workflow that can block PRs (supp-4) back up enforcement. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that custom rules are reliably enforced (the only community mention says learning "supposedly" improves), and explicit support for externally linked style-guide URLs beyond in-repo guideline files.
